study.question: Does a fixed blend of separately normalized complete mean and DIN history summaries exceed both single-summary endpoints and the frozen source bests at the same active parameter count, after fieldwise summary-source mixing failed to beat compact_mean?
study.hypothesis: Observed: compact_mean macro AUC 0.8307402933986681 exceeds compact_din 0.8304973270842566 and g0 0.8301982212762624 at one seed, but buy AUC is 0.8957034513131672 versus 0.8969904606096766 for compact_din and 0.8971639278935442 for g0. The two coordinate-spliced item/action arms scored 0.8305197941755058 and 0.8301172049141192 and did not beat compact_mean; the latter recovered buy to 0.8972303942587978 while worsening macro AUC. These observations do not prove an item/action binding mechanism. A testable explanation is that complete target-independent mean and target-conditioned signed DIN summaries carry complementary directions, whereas coordinate splicing disrupts joint item/action geometry. A fixed equally weighted blend after a shared low-rank map and separate affine-free normalization may expose both directions without extra learned capacity. One controlled gain is only local support; repetition and all-task trade-offs remain necessary.

nearest_work.difference: Reuse both complete-summary endpoints and every active map/initialization. Replace a single endpoint, or an item/action coordinate splice before projection, by equal fusion of two separately normalized whole-vector transforms through the same maps. No added learned gate or widened bottleneck.

The author source warns that its historical data lacks item IDs; current authorized inputs contain previous advertisement IDs plus five item attributes and action. No DMR reproduction or mechanism claim is made, and no inputs or auxiliary labels are reinterpreted.

inherited_components: Entire frozen g0 joint-separate representation and feedback memory from g0-r0011-memory_joint_separate
Compact mean/DIN residual maps and initialization replay/pruning from g1-r0009-compact_mean and g1-r0009-compact_din
Global signed DIN summary, 35 relation/temporal tokens, feature tokens, four prediction towers and existing input sanitization
Host data construction, masked history, four-task sum-BCE, optimizers, selection metric and validation-only feedback
study.proposed_difference: Let m be the inherited masked mean of all seven event fields, d the inherited global signed DIN sum, and f(s)=LN(value_up(value_down(s))) with exactly the inherited shared maps and affine-free LayerNorm. coherent_blend uses output(0.5*f(m)+0.5*f(d)); mean_compute_control uses output(1*f(m)+0*f(d)). Both calculate m, d and both f calls with identical shapes/parameters; the zero coefficient remains in the control computation graph. The output map is the inherited zero-start map. Do not normalize the fused result again. This is a fixed single contrast, not a coefficient sweep. All four tasks receive the same complete residual source. Expected active parameter count remains 33,042,117; host verification required.
predictions: Primary directional prediction: coherent_blend validation four-task macro AUC exceeds the matched mean_compute_control, existing compact_mean 0.8307402933986681, compact_din 0.8304973270842566, g0 0.8301982212762624 and g1 source 0.8192325306335276. Gains must be assessed with parameter and measured training/inference cost.

Secondary exploratory prediction: buy AUC recovers some of the compact_mean-to-compact_din gap without erasing the mean endpoint gains on other tasks. There is no per-task veto or purchase-driven selection rule. Record all four AUC/Logloss deltas against DIN baseline, g0 entry, both endpoints and the compute control.

Host initialization check: both new arms have identical parameter tensors and caller CPU RNG state; zero-start predictions agree with the compact endpoint/g0 prediction path within predeclared FP32/BF16 tolerances. uniform mode agrees with historical compact_mean; din mode agrees with historical compact_din with matched arbitrary active residual weights. These are requirements to verify, not measured results.

Existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history slices are exploratory only. Report samples and each positive/negative count from authorized validation diagnostics. Empty-history buy has only 13 positives and is insufficient for a strong task-specific conclusion. No new slice boundary is selected from validation outcomes.
falsifiers: If coherent_blend fails to exceed the mean compute control and stronger endpoint, complementary predictive utility is unsupported for this fixed implementation; retain incumbent rather than tuning blend weights on the same evidence.

If mean_compute_control changes validation meaningfully from compact_mean, first treat initialization, numerical or optimization differences as unresolved; do not attribute that change to new summary information. Do not retrain automatically when execution state is unknown.

If apparent improvement disappears or reverses in paired seed repetitions or a feasible paired user-cluster bootstrap interval includes material negative effects, retain a preliminary or null conclusion rather than claiming repeated support.

If masking, no-current-action leakage, finite gradients, output contract, parameter equality or resource limits fail, the attempt is an execution/integrity failure rather than scientific evidence against summary complementarity.

Even a repeatable blend gain would not identify why complete vectors matter: this study cannot distinguish preservation of item/action binding from scale normalization, regularization or gradient sharing without further mechanism contrasts.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed optimizer path and validation selection noise; replay of the same seed is not independent repetition.
Shared-map normalization/gradient averaging can regularize the model; a gain need not indicate additional information or semantic binding.
Opposing complete summary directions may cancel; separate normalization discards DIN intensity, although the original raw DIN tower input is preserved. A null result only rejects this implementation.
Common extra f(d) work can change numerical reduction ordering and wall cost even for zero coefficient; nominally equal parameters do not guarantee equal measured compute.
Long-history prevalence, sparse buy positives and offline feedback visibility may drive apparent task/slice trade-offs; no production causality or generalization beyond this benchmark is claimed.
Earlier adaptive/prior and rotated routes did not establish adaptive-query complementarity. This fixed blend cannot retroactively support g1 learned retrieval or the original industrial method.

No failed host execution is recorded in the supplied current-phase context (previous_runtime_error is null). Successful-but-unhelpful adaptive, prior and coordinate-splice branches are retained as negative comparative evidence; missing full primary texts and missing local tensor execution are availability limits, not scientific failures.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Submit only two complete full-protocol variants: one blend and one same-computation mean control, estimated 550s each (1100s total) plus about 150s numerical preflight; existing DIN-summary endpoint is the active capacity replacement. Equal expected parameters 33,042,117 (19,712 above g0); a second shared f call adds 28,672 linear multiply-accumulates per example at V=112, width=32, four task copies, plus normalization. These are analytical estimates, not measured runtime. Record total/embedding/dense parameters, active gradients, train wall time, inference seconds, throughput, batch latency and peak memory. Retain all failures and never raise the cap.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve approximately 2200s for up to four further 550s full-unit runs: two additional paired seeds for the selected blend and closest mean control (target three seeds including this pair), only if the later authorized phase permits changing host repetition seeds and actual remaining budget fits. No seed or frozen training setting is changed in model config. An additional repeated g0/DIN endpoint would be desirable but is not funded by this reserve; report any omitted repetitions. Use historical endpoints only with matching hashes/preflight. Freeze the validation comparison suite before final assessment. Test is unavailable and closed outputs must not be read. Total planned preflight+initial pair+repetition reserve is 3450s before agent overhead; residual ~299s at entry is not guaranteed slack.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Check host remaining ledger before each complete unit. No extra sweep; stop this branch after the pair unless a predeclared assessment repetition fits. If current preparation or measured unit times leave insufficient paired-assessment reserve, prioritize frozen incumbent-versus-closest-control validation assessment and omit new repeats explicitly. Do not launch a unit likely to exceed its 1208.541s cap or the global deadline. Never consume assessment reserves on routine retries; unknown execution state requires receipt reconciliation, not a duplicate. One-seed findings remain preliminary; exhausted resources are not success. The runtime snapshot does not expose a callable training or repetition command in this phase; this submission is proposal-only. variants.note: Prospective untrained standalone module; source SHA256 91049ddac04739c95e9839facd0cb2239538dd37e1732c79a60fd8825f9fe95e. Local syntax/compile, literal CONFIG, allowed-import, arm equivalence outside CONFIG, and inherited helper/constructor/forward AST checks passed. PyTorch, NumPy and jsonschema are absent; no installation, training or tensor execution performed. Public inputs comprise supplied code, validation receipts and authorized source text. Raw parquet and GPU execution are not locally available; original data digest/readiness gates are inherited from the frozen host protocol and successful reference receipts, not reverified here. Host preflight before any training: instantiate with the frozen real FeatureMap and verify all four label probabilities have [B,1] shape and are finite; test FP32 and frozen BF16 autocast forward, sum-four-BCE and backward. Cover length 0, all padded, singleton, full 100-event and mixed history; overlapping and all-zero task masks. Changing only masked IDs/actions or the current action must leave outputs unchanged with fixed model mode/RNG. Check exact equality of same-seed state_dict keys, shapes and parameter tensors between arms, equality of caller CPU RNG state, zero output initialization, and inherited parameter tensors versus compact_mean. Using identical arbitrary nonzero active residual weights, uniform mode must agree with committed compact_mean and din mode with committed compact_din. Prediction tolerance: FP32 atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5; BF16 atol=2e-3, rtol=1e-2; report maximum discrepancies and do not silently relax tolerances. Zero-start prediction parity with frozen g0 is a separate check. Compare finite gradients and endpoint gradient parity (FP32 atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4; BF16 atol=1e-2, rtol=5e-2), recording any failures. Since zero-start output blocks upstream branch gradients initially, verify sensitivity and nonzero finite branch/map gradients after a controlled nonzero output perturbation or the first valid optimizer update; do not misclassify expected initial zeros as an implementation failure. Verify uniform control derivative through the additional DIN transform is zero and blend derivative reaches both summary sources; every shared map remains active in both arms. Check expected total parameters 33,042,117 and record actual training/inference/peak-memory costs. Tensor tests and host scoring have not been run in this coding environment.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read pinned HyFormerBlock.forward and benchmark description; original paper has no detailed authorized text. Previous local adaptive/rotation trajectories do not support adding repeated learned queries. Its fixed-versus-learned-summary question is relevant context only.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No HyFormer operation adopted. Fixed complete-summary fusion uses only inherited mean/DIN pooling and shared maps.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No sequence re-encoder, query decoding, query booster or newly learned routing. This is a controlled adaptation of existing local residual summaries; novelty remains unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Failure against equal-capacity complete-summary endpoints and the common-computation mean control leaves fixed-summary complementarity unsupported. Success cannot establish adaptive-query or HyFormer mechanism effectiveness.
